doc.title: Steve Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Thanks and goodbye
summary: Rowe thanks Allen, who praises the archive's work, and they sign off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’m most appreciative of your time.

Well you should be at these prices. No I’m honored to be invited, because what we’re laying down here, what you guys are establishing, preserving in your library, is very important. Because while it’s fun to be 77 years old, I’m not going to be around for a great deal longer, and so — oh here comes death now, and I’ll do one of those.
We’d better sign off then. Thanks so much.
Thank you very much. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -23-
